layout: Each data file is {"fields": [names], "rows": [[values in that order]]}. Zip a row with `fields` to get a record.
null_semantics: A null value always has a reason: the row's `nulls` field maps every null field to a code in `null_reasons`. No field carries a default number in place of a missing one. A consumer must treat an unknown code as 'unknown'.
versioning: Within v1 no field is removed, renamed or redefined and no reason code changes meaning. New fields (appended to `fields`) and new reason codes may be added, and the minor version rises. A breaking change ships as exports/v2 beside v1.
ratings: Player ratings are on a fixed 30-99 scale with absolute anchors (the same production earns the same number in any season); a 99 is not guaranteed to exist in a season. Three player ratings are never merged: rating_prev (last season, earned), projection (this season, preseason), rating_to_date (this season, earned so far). Ratings measure box-score production adjusted for the opponent; they are not physical attributes.
not_in_v1: individual offensive-line ratings (withheld everywhere, not only here)
physical or skill attributes (speed, strength, accuracy)
past seasons other than last season's final rating

null_reasons.withheld_ol: An offensive lineman: no public source has individual blocking data, so no individual rating or projection is made (a standing decision since v4.3; the team's line is rated as a unit instead). Not missing: withheld.
null_reasons.no_prev_season: Not on a roster of ours last season (a freshman, or new to FBS), so there is no last-season rating.
null_reasons.prev_not_rated: On a roster last season but carries no rating of ours for it.
null_reasons.not_projected: No projection was made for this season (a late arrival or a walk-on who has since played).
null_reasons.no_box_score_rows: No box-score row this season yet. Not the same as zero games: box scores list only players who recorded a statistic.
null_reasons.no_rating_this_season: The team has no rating for this season (it has no games or no roster reading on file).
null_reasons.no_recruiting_record: No recruiting record matched to this player (unrecruited, or a record that could not be matched).
null_reasons.class_year_unknown: Neither a recruiting class nor a first FBS season is on file, so the class year cannot be derived.
null_reasons.not_in_source: The source file has no value for this field.

teams.json.rows: one per FBS team in the app's teams.json

fields.name: team_id
fields.meaning: CollegeFootballData team id; the key players.team_id refers to

fields.name: rating_prev
fields.meaning: Last completed season's team rating (the headline: 1/6 roster, 1/6 stats, 2/3 results)

fields.name: projection
fields.meaning: This season's preseason team rating (built from the projected roster)

fields.name: rating_to_date
fields.meaning: This season's team rating from its games so far

fields.name: power_to_date
fields.meaning: Power, what teams are ranked by: points per game above an average FBS team; while a season is being played it is the games alone

fields.name: results_to_date
fields.meaning: The results reading (points scored and prevented against the schedule)

fields.name: wins
fields.meaning: Wins this season so far (regular season)

fields.name: nulls
fields.meaning: For every null field in this row, why: {field: reason code}. Empty when nothing is null.
fields.range: keys are field names; values are codes from null_reasons

players.json.rows: one per player on a roster this season

fields.name: player_id
fields.meaning: CollegeFootballData athlete id, stable across seasons

fields.name: team_id
fields.meaning: The team whose roster he is on this season; joins teams.team_id

fields.name: position
fields.meaning: Position as the source roster lists it: the API's coarse label (OL, DB, LS, ATH ...), not a depth-chart slot; often absent

fields.name: position_group
fields.meaning: The group he is rated in
fields.range: QB RB WR TE OL DL EDGE LB CB S DB K P (and ATH, LS where the roster says so)

fields.name: class_year
fields.meaning: Year in college (1 = first year), derived from his recruiting class or first FBS season

fields.name: rating_prev
fields.meaning: Last completed season's earned rating (box-score production, opponent-adjusted, on fixed anchors)

fields.name: projection
fields.meaning: This season's preseason projection (Engine D career curve, or recruiting / carry-forward where it has no history)

fields.name: projection_low
fields.meaning: Low end of the projection's 80% interval

fields.name: projection_high
fields.meaning: High end of the projection's 80% interval

fields.name: rating_to_date
fields.meaning: This season's earned rating from the games played so far (the level he has played at, through the part-season curve)

fields.name: games_to_date
fields.meaning: Games with a box-score row this season. Not counted for kickers and punters, whose rating comes from season totals (null, not_in_source)

fields.name: nulls
fields.meaning: For every null field in this row, why: {field: reason code}. Empty when nothing is null.
fields.range: keys are field names; values are codes from null_reasons

manifest.json.rows: one object: what was exported, from which model, when, and each file's sha256
